content:
Every service comes with a responsibility, and every consumer deserves accountability.

Raising genuine concerns is not about spreading negativity it's about encouraging better service standards and transparent grievance redressal. When customers speak up respectfully, businesses get an opportunity to improve.

Appreciating Aanchal Tiwari for sharing her experience with professionalism and facts. I hope the matter is resolved fairly and at the earliest.

Consumer awareness is not criticism it is a step towards accountability.

Aanchal T
